title: A Kafka Connect REST API is reachable
summary: The Kafka Connect API answers unauthenticated.  It can be made to load a connector, a known path to code execution.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("kafka_cluster_id") and body_contains("version") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication on the Connect REST API and keep it off the public internet.
